question: Does one minimal research-only TARGET_ACTS_LAST_THIS_PHASE representation have an exact disabled whole-run path and affect only its frozen phase-order mediator in matched direct controls?

immutableEvidence.closedFamilyRule: Every prior valid closed-family disposition remains immutable and unavailable as a rescue path.

targetActsLast.definition: Before the next enemy phase resolves any living enemy, stable-partition the existing living-enemy iteration so the marked enemy acts after every unmarked enemy. Preserve each enemy's exact move, internal effect order, action count, player target, history update, RNG identity and post-phase intent recomputation; consume the marker at phase start.

levels.off: Prototype switch false; the research card cannot create or consume a marker.
levels.on: Prototype switch true; a Duskblade research Skill costing one Energy marks exactly one selected living enemy for the next enemy phase.

targetActsLast.carrier: EnemyCombatant.flags[research421TargetActsLast] on at most one living enemy; omitted from CombatState, RunState and save projections.
targetActsLast.repeatRule: Same-target replay is idempotent; different-target replay replaces the marker without stacking.
targetActsLast.expiry: Marked-target death, combat end, aspect mismatch or the next enemy-phase consumption clears the marker.

event.cardinality: Exactly one event per eligible phase consumption and zero otherwise.

scorelinePayoff.definition: Duskblade exact Chisel realised hit sets one target-local non-stacking mark; a later exact Executioner on that living target consumes it for one separate bounded raw damage operation.
scorelinePayoff.causalIndependence: Separate causal factor; never pooled with targetActsLast.

afterimagePayoff.definition: Duskblade exact Defend realised Ward sets one player-local non-stacking bounded value; a later exact Warden's Edge in the same player turn consumes it for one separate mirrored-Ward operation.
afterimagePayoff.causalIndependence: Separate causal factor; never pooled with targetActsLast.

acquisitionPriority.definition: The already identity-proved deterministic reward-value mediator from the earlier blocked package experiment.
acquisitionPriority.role: Frozen and not varied in this identity gate.

factorDefinitions.interactionRule: No interaction is estimated. Scoreline, Afterimage, acquisition and every prior package remain fixed at their null levels. Any later joint cell requires a new decision-valued interference preregistration.

researchPrototype.productStatus: Research-only source/content projection; not product truth, a candidate or shipping scope.
prohibitions: No new declared combat, enemy, run or save field
No policy score, target heuristic, acquisition override, ML or RL hook

estimator.wholeRun: Current-main BalanceSim.simulate under a frozen BalancePolicy identity.
estimator.pathCapture: The single research probe repeats the exact current-main orchestration through BalanceSim's existing helpers, records every selected node and complete combat event queue, and must reproduce the canonical BalanceSim.simulate row for the same identity before any arm comparison.
estimator.direct: GlassvowGame.apply through the production startCombat, playCard and endTurn seams from one frozen constructed state per scenario.
estimator.canonicalisation: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators plus one LF; equality is exact, not tolerant.
estimator.cache: Deterministic SHA-256 content, plan and output objects only; no adaptive reuse or row selection.

arms: Exact current-main source plus exact current-main content
Prototype source at its default-false null plus exact current-main content
estimands: Result and all existing field equality
wholeRunNull.aliasStructure: A success establishes exact-main and default-false prototype as one null equivalence class only.

matchedDirect.commonConditions: Same source, projected content, constructed state, actions, seed identity, RNG cursor, baseline, estimator and stopping rule.
estimands: Two positive phase-order consumptions preserve action multiset and RNG while removing exactly one +2 same-phase Strength exposure each
Ashwarden rejection and dead-target rejection are exact nulls
Same-target replay is idempotent and different-target replay replaces
Already-last consumption has moved=false and an exact ordinary path
Marked-target death and combat end clear the marker with an exact ordinary path
matchedDirect.aliasStructure: Ash rejection, dead-target rejection, expiry and already-last ordinary paths must alias explicit false after removing only the research marker/event surface. Positive moved=true rows must not alias because phase order and its exact damage mediator change.

anchors: Every whole-run identity is a shared common-random-number exact-main/default-false anchor.
Every direct scenario uses explicit false as its matched anchor.
No cross-package interference anchor is needed because no other payoff or acquisition factor varies.

stoppingRule.success: All immutable inputs, fresh unprotected identities, parse checks, estimator-equivalence checks, whole-run null rows and direct mediator/lifecycle checks pass exactly.
stoppingRule.futility: A valid executable representation fails any parse, disabled identity, intended-mediator or lifecycle check. Close this representation/family and continue inside #421 with the next distinct evidence-backed structural mechanism.
stoppingRule.inconclusive: Any authority, source, engine, ledger, schema, process, cache, wall-time, row-cap or execution-validity fault prevents a scientific result and records this gate inconclusive at its cap.
stoppingRule.noAdaptiveRescue: No seed, scenario, policy, threshold, content, source or cohort may be replaced after execution starts.

decision.success: Authorise only a separately preregistered natural-capacity screen for this exact representation. Do not produce causal, candidate, held-out or product rows here.
decision.futility: Close TARGET_ACTS_LAST_THIS_PHASE at this representation gate and continue inside #421 with the next distinct evidence-backed structural mechanism; no V39-style tuning.
decision.inconclusive: Record an inconclusive identity result at the preregistered cap and do not infer mechanism failure.

claimBoundary: A success proves exact disabled-path identity and direct representation/mediator isolation for the tested source, content, identities and Godot provenance only. It is not natural capacity, policy sensitivity, causal benefit, complementarity, reachability, a feasible candidate, product scope, held-out confirmation, #421 acceptance or the #108 P9 receipt.
